items.event_title: Dell raises annual revenue and profit forecasts again as AI server demand drives record results
items.news_summary: Dell lifted full-year revenue guidance to about $192 billion and adjusted EPS guidance to $25.50 after record quarterly revenue, citing exceptionally strong AI-optimized server demand and a large order/backlog pipeline.
items.investor_materiality: Direct read-through for Dell, Nvidia, CoreWeave and the broader AI server/storage/data-center supply chain; the magnitude of the guidance increase can reset expectations for AI infrastructure spending.
items.selection_reason: Largest clean U.S. tech earnings catalyst in the window, with both a major guidance raise and a strong premarket stock reaction.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters earnings coverage and follow-up market reaction; company figures are quoted in Reuters reporting.

items.event_title: Palo Alto Networks beats quarterly estimates and acquires AI security platform Console
items.news_summary: Palo Alto Networks beat quarterly estimates on AI-driven cybersecurity demand and announced another acquisition, buying Console to strengthen agentic/AI security capabilities.
items.investor_materiality: Combines a fresh earnings beat with ongoing M&A and platform consolidation, affecting PANW growth expectations and competitive positioning across cloud and AI security.
items.selection_reason: High-quality dual catalyst: earnings plus strategic acquisition in a core AI/cybersecurity theme.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report based on company results and acquisition announcement.

items.event_title: Global bond selloff deepens as oil and inflation fears push yields higher
items.news_summary: U.S. stocks weakened as Treasury and global sovereign yields climbed while oil prices rose amid renewed Middle East risk. Japan's 10-year government bond yield reached 3%, its highest in roughly 30 years.
items.investor_materiality: Higher discount rates pressure long-duration growth stocks and can alter Fed/BOJ expectations, dollar moves, gold and equity risk premiums simultaneously.
items.selection_reason: Broad cross-asset catalyst affecting virtually all U.S. equity sectors, especially technology.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters global markets and sovereign-bond reporting.
items.youtube_query: Treasury yields oil inflation stock market
items.video_angle: 真正压美股的不是油价，而是全球债券一起重新定价。

items.event_title: Micron Taiwan unions threaten strike over bonus dispute
items.news_summary: Micron's Taiwan labor unions moved toward possible strike action in a dispute over bonuses, creating an operational risk around important memory-chip production capacity.
items.investor_materiality: Micron is a major U.S.-listed DRAM/HBM supplier; any production interruption in Taiwan could tighten memory supply and affect AI server and HBM pricing expectations.
items.selection_reason: Concrete supply-chain risk in one of the most important AI memory names.
items.youtube_query: Micron MU Taiwan strike HBM memory
items.video_angle: 美光台湾工厂如果罢工，HBM 和 DRAM 会不会再涨一轮？

items.event_title: Taiwan says its companies plan another $20 billion of U.S. investment driven by AI demand
items.news_summary: Taiwan said its companies are planning roughly another $20 billion of U.S. investment as AI demand drives additional semiconductor and technology capacity localization.
items.investor_materiality: Potential beneficiaries and affected supply chains include foundries, packaging, equipment, power and U.S. data-center infrastructure; it also reinforces the geographic shift of Asian chip capex into the U.S.
items.selection_reason: Large quantified cross-border semiconductor/AI capex signal with direct U.S. industrial relevance.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report citing Taiwan government statements.
items.video_angle: 台湾科技公司再投美国 200 亿美元：这笔 AI 资本开支最终会流到谁手里？

items.event_title: Chevron expands Venezuela position with more than $7 billion planned investment
items.news_summary: Chevron agreed to updated terms for its Venezuela joint ventures and plans more than $7 billion of investment over five years, targeting a substantial increase in crude production.
items.investor_materiality: Material for Chevron's upstream production growth and potentially for global crude supply, oil prices and U.S. energy-sector earnings expectations.
items.selection_reason: Large, quantified capital commitment by a mega-cap U.S. energy company with macro oil implications.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report with company and government context.
items.video_angle: Chevron 重押委内瑞拉 70 亿美元：油价高位时为什么反而扩产？

items.event_title: South Korea proposes record 2027 budget with major AI investment push
items.news_summary: South Korea proposed a record roughly $597 billion 2027 budget, emphasizing AI investment and technology competitiveness as part of an aggressive fiscal expansion.
items.investor_materiality: Supports Korean semiconductor, memory and AI infrastructure spending, with read-through for Samsung, SK hynix, Nvidia and global equipment suppliers.
items.selection_reason: Large sovereign spending signal concentrated in AI and semiconductors.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage of the Korean government's budget proposal.
items.youtube_query: South Korea 2027 budget AI semiconductor investment
items.video_angle: 韩国把财政预算押向 AI：三星、SK 海力士会不会迎来新一轮政策红利？

items.event_title: BOJ's Takata calls for nimble rate hikes as Japan enters a 2026 turning point
items.news_summary: Hawkish BOJ board member Hajime Takata argued for flexible, meeting-by-meeting rate hikes as inflation and global conditions evolve, while Japanese government bond yields remain elevated.
items.investor_materiality: A faster BOJ tightening path can move yen funding costs, global bond yields and carry trades, feeding directly into U.S. risk assets.
items.selection_reason: Fresh central-bank signal with global rates and liquidity consequences.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters report based on BOJ policymaker remarks.
items.youtube_query: BOJ Takata rate hike Japan bond yields
items.video_angle: 日本央行如果加快加息，为什么美股也可能被抽走流动性？

items.event_title: G20 finance chiefs except China back action against distorted trade
items.news_summary: The United States won support from G20 finance leaders other than China for action against non-market policies and trade distortions, adding to the risk of broader coordinated trade measures.
items.investor_materiality: Could affect China-exposed multinationals, industrial supply chains, semiconductors, autos and inflation expectations if translated into tariffs or other restrictions.
items.selection_reason: Fresh multilateral trade-policy escalation with broad U.S.-equity sector implications.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters coverage of G20 finance discussions and U.S. policy push.
items.video_angle: 这次不只是美国对中国：G20 贸易战会不会开始“组队”？

items.event_title: South Korean FX authorities buy about $20 billion in dollars from repatriated SK hynix ADR proceeds
items.news_summary: South Korean FX authorities reportedly purchased around $20 billion of dollars that SK hynix repatriated after its large U.S. ADR issuance, using the flow to help manage currency-market volatility and reserves.
items.investor_materiality: Highlights the extraordinary scale of SK hynix's AI/HBM financing and creates an unusual link between semiconductor capital raising, won liquidity and Korean FX policy.
items.selection_reason: Large quantified capital-flow event tied directly to a key Nvidia/HBM supplier.
items.source_quality_note: Reuters exclusive/source-based reporting; official parties had not commented at publication.
